;; In a bare lisp ....
(load '((lisp) string))

`(foo ,"bar")
(FOO "bar")

`(foo "bar")
(FOO T)

;; really !

;;; without the string package loaded you get the usual
`(foo "bar") --> (FOO |bar|)
`(foo ,"bar") --> (FOO |bar|)
